consequence.statement: Existing ImageUpdateAutomation objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten, so a storage version migration (re-write all objects and update status.storedVersions on the imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD) must be completed before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, run the storage version migration: re-write all ImageUpdateAutomation objects so they are stored at v1, then update status.storedVersions on the imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD to drop v1beta2, before upgrading to the later release that removes v1beta2.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing ImageUpdateAutomation objects stay stored as v1beta2 until a storage version migration (re-writing all objects and updating status.storedVersions) is run before a later release removes v1beta2.
